label: No input type supplies a complete edge: screenshots give order and trigger, frames give hierarchy and names, docs give conditions and outcomes, so source-target-condition must always be synthesized.

label: The six FigJam write verbs cap the model: sticky, shape and text create nodes, connect creates edges, move and update position or relabel; images, tables, code blocks and sections are outside the documented surface.
Connector creation needs node ids, but the skill documents no return contract for creation verbs; the only documented way to resolve ids is reading them back through fj nodes or fj info.

The minimum representation is nodes with id, kind (start, end, step, decision, state, note), label, platform and source pointer; edges with source, target and optional condition; plus layout order and grouping hints because no automatic layout verb exists.
Evidence-bearing nodes are cheap because Product Owner already gates completion on read-back, so each node can carry its source path while the board stays the only delivered artifact.
Because the topic names FigJam as the only output, the intermediate model must stay transient as a fenced block inside the markdown receipt rather than becoming a second deliverable.
